architecture.assessment: Pass for the local queue: one cohesive 90-line owner, no new partial or public interface; nested Entry/Waiter/Lease are private data and lifetime details, independently exercised by nine pure tests. The sole additional finding is informational member-count (nine source members); splitting this queue would increase responsibility scattering. Existing HistoricalReadStore containment cycle is unchanged. No project or registration edits.
architecture.limitations: Scoped CodeAnalytics retains ten NuGet audit/MSBuild load diagnostics and cannot attest a complete transitive project graph. Direct affected Release builds pass; project file diff is empty. No new module dependency is introduced.

review.status: Intentional single added path-api finding; no stale or other added protected findings.
review.reason: Path.GetFullPath normalizes the layout-owned workspace lock identity using platform APIs. No hard-coded drive, separator, current-directory assumption in production layout, or OS-specific primitive was introduced. Different physical aliases remain protected by the existing OS file lock; local scheduling explicitly does not promise alias discovery. Nine pure queue cases and native File regressions pass.
